title: Flooded Roadway Warning System
categories: Creeks, Streams, Storm Drains, and Waterways
description: Use this service request to report a high water sign or location needing maintenance or repair. NOTE: There are 42 Flooding Roadway Warning Systems high water locations throughout the City of Dallas. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 5 business days.

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request to repair a flooded-roadway warning sign or light.
actions.why: Report maintenance or repair needed at a City high-water or flooded-roadway warning location. The 311 request form covers a damaged or knocked-down sign, warning lights that fail to flash or remain stuck, and other system problems, and asks for the nearest cross street or intersection.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Creeks, Streams, Storm Drains, and Waterways" > Choose "Flooded Roadway Warning System"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Creeks, Streams, Storm Drains, and Waterways" > Choose "Flooded Roadway Warning System"
